en: The front side of the postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a European street lined with traditional half-timbered houses and a church with a tall spire in the background. People and a horse-drawn cart are visible on the cobblestone street. The text on the top left of the image identifies the street and the church. The reverse side of the postcard bears a printed museum stamp, lines for an address, and some handwritten numbers. The left margin includes the name of a publisher or photographer and a town name.
